scope.content: Appendix1 printed867–873, Appendix2 printed875–893 including all14exercises and hints, bibliography printed895–901 with163entries.
scope.method: Personally viewed every original full-page PNG via view_image, read complete English and Chinese manuscripts, and compared all paragraphs, definitions, theorem statements, proof steps, formulas, exponents, indices, quantifiers and cross-page fragments. For bibliography compared every entry's key, authors, original and translated title, publication, series/volume/issue/year/page data and all edition/reprint/conference qualifiers. No review flag, embedded OCR or another agent's assertion was used as evidence. SHA-256 values bind each review to the complete final EN and ZH file bytes; hashes captured after corrections and earlier hashes checked for drift.
